title: Field Technician Trainee
responsibilities: Assist senior technicians with on-site equipment installs and repairs
Complete a structured 6-month field-technician certification track
Log service visits and parts usage in the field service app
Represent the company professionally at customer sites
minimumRequirements: High school diploma or equivalent; technical coursework a plus
Valid driver's license and clean driving record
Willingness to work outdoors and travel regionally
preferredRequirements: Mechanical aptitude or hands-on trade/athletics background
physicalRequirements: Able to lift up to 50 lbs
Able to climb, kneel, and work in varied outdoor conditions
careerPath: Field Technician Trainee -> Field Technician -> Senior Field Technician
